name: SPICE-derived model with actual RTL
fidelity: Actual RTL plus reduced-order analog model; RC and SKY130 comparator delay characterized online; mismatch/noise/leakage/reference impedance assumed

provenance.coverage: Delay interpolation validated on positive overdrives at VCM 0.9 V, VDD 1.8 V, 27 C. Below-range logarithmic extrapolation and above-range clamping are conservative modelling assumptions, not SPICE validation.
